column3: A link target of loadfunc wrappers over libcfunc.so, the same dynamic-loading dependency as general/cfuncs.icn and general/extlvals.icn: a driver cannot be cut until ipl/cfuncs is vendored and loadfunc runs. Reclassified from REF_NOT_CUT by hq_icon 2026-09-25 -- still owed. Prior note: GRADABLE: a link target with no `procedure main`, so it cannot run standalone -- but a DRIVER that `link`s it and exercises its documented procedures grades it, the pattern proven 144 times in packages/snobol4/gimpel (CEO-700, Lon: "we did it for the beauty test suite"). OWED, never excluded. Prior evidence: IPL library module, NOT an arizona test: ipl/cfuncs/cfunc.icn, vendored as a link target (corpus 8f29d1dc3). Zero `procedure main` in the file, so the oracle cannot run it standalone -- it is a LINK TARGET for tests that `link` it. Upstream tests/general does not ship it (we ship 123 .icn there, upstream ships 99; all 24 extras are these). Oracle standalone: File cfunc.icn; Line 34 # ";": invalid declaration ⛔ ALSO BROKEN BY OUR OWN VENDORING EDIT, not by the oracle: CONTROL -- icont -s -c compiles upstream ipl/cfuncs/cfunc.icn cleanly and REFUSES this copy (File cfunc.icn; Line 34 # ";": invalid declaration). Cause: a blanket semicolon pass that also hit $-preprocessor directives and declarations, which take no ';'.
